data.long_meaning: The name Rosalinda is derived from the Latin and Greek roots: Rosa (rose) and linda (beautiful or gentle). The name symbolizes beauty, grace, and strength, much like the flower it is named after. In Christian tradition, the rose is a symbol of the Virgin Mary and her purity. The name Rosalinda carries the meaning “Precious rose” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rosalinda usually hope their child will grow to embody precious rose and live with faith, good character and purpose.
